hook.name: Pangea Fee Hook
hook.description: Fee hook for Pangea launch pools that charges a fixed-rate fee (0.3%–5%) in the quote asset on every swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, crediting fees as ERC-6909 claims to a per-pool fee splitter. Restricts liquidity additions to an authorized seeder, exempts the dev buyer from fees, and reverts swaps that would move the pool price past the launch range boundary.
